test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

One who interferes in the affairs of others, often for selfish reasons
solution:
The correct answer is '**interloper**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given group of words is '**interloper**'.
 
• **Interloper**: a person who becomes involved in a place or situation where they are not wanted or are considered not to belong. (जो दूसरों के मामलों में अक्सर स्वार्थी कारणों से दखल देता है)
 
 
• *Example: When he came back from the war he felt like an **interloper** in his own family.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Interloper.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Foreigner**: a person who belongs to a country that is not your own. (आपने देश से भिन्‍न देश का निवासी; विदेशी व्‍यक्ति)
 
• **Interpreter**: a person whose job is to translate what somebody is saying immediately into another language. (एक भाषा से दूसरी भाषा में मौखिक अनुवाद करने वाला व्‍यक्ति, मौखिक अनुवादक; भाष्‍यकार)
 
• **Strange**: unusual or unexpected. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित; विचित्र; अजीब)
